entities.name: IGPD C0QUG8
observations: Exact 194-aa sequence match to reviewed Persephonella marina imidazoleglycerol-phosphate dehydratase (UniProt C0QUG8).
Catalyzes D-erythro-1-(imidazol-4-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate dehydration to 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate and water; EC 4.2.1.19.
Annotated in cytoplasm and L-histidine biosynthesis, step 6/9.
Pfam IGPD domain PF00475.25 spans residues 31–174.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: IGPD participates in L-histidine biosynthesis at step 6/9, as annotated for the exact-match reference protein.

entities.name: IGPD enzyme activity
observations: EC 4.2.1.19; Rhea RHEA:11040 describes dehydration of imidazoleglycerol phosphate to an imidazole-containing oxopropyl phosphate plus water.
